[[Malinon's Shield]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[Malinon Threshammer]], a [[boss]] who is found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Tactics]])
:[[Health]]  +45 (while [[Enchantment spell|Enchanted]])
:Received [[Physical damage]] -2 (while [[Enchantment spell|Enchanted]])

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Shield of the Wing]] and [[Aegis (shield)|Aegis]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Shield of the Wing|Tactics Shield of the Wing]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Shield Handle]] [[of Devotion]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Sheltered by Faith]]" inscription


Except for the visual appearance, exact technical replicas for this item are:
*[[Adamantine Shield]] from collector [[Haibir]] or crafters [[Grif Ebonmane]], [[Kehjim]], or [[Wisseh]]
*[[Bronze Shield]] from crafter [[Nago]]
*[[Wooden Buckler]] from collector [[Luci]]
